maddeler.e:
استهلكوا (form X)
# اِسْتَهْلَكُوا (istahlakū) /is.tah.la.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# اُسْتُهْلِكُوا (ustuhlikū) /us.tuh.li.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# اِسْتَهْلِكُوا (istahlikū) /is.tah.li.kuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
